args.summary: Version v2.3.1 of checkout-api failed health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an error rate of 0.18 following the latest deploy. Rolled back to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production, in all regions. Rollback verified and rolled out to us-east, us-west, and eu-west.
args.title: checkout-api health check failures after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Diagnosed**: checkout-api was running v2.3.1, which was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. The most recent release that was healthy in production was **v2.3.0**.

2. **Rolled back**: checkout-api is now back on v2.3.0 in all production regions — the rollback rolled out successfully and was verified.

3. **Opened incident**: Created **SEV2 incident INC-0001** ("checkout-api health check failures after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0") describing the failures and the rollback action. The on-call engineer has been paged.

Note: the v2.3.1 release should be investigated before any re-attempt, as it was unhealthy both in staging (v2.3.1-rc) and production.
